lxc_e4ae4e68e12c3b31.text: Table tennis is fast, but small actions can change the ball.

lxc_7e906debc445ee01.text: Explore spin, a legal serve, the sport’s early days, and two Olympic stars.

lxc_7d3680719fe2f51b.text: Watch how simple movements create exciting play.

lxc_3a53c1619727a0a2.text: Players brush the ball with the racket to make spin.

lxc_7e7fb6bbd07d0620.text: The three basic kinds are topspin, backspin, and sidespin.

lxc_2cf4ac04d0172224.text: Topspin makes the ball dip and move forward quickly after the bounce.

lxc_622b31821458e059.text: Backspin can make it stay low and slow.

lxc_947a184da08cd833.text: Sidespin can make it curve left or right.

lxc_e0dd898d236c99c5.text: Spin is often hard to see before the bounce.

lxc_cf8cb4c0f338eb9c.text: Its effect is easier to see after the ball hits the table.

lxc_c3d5f0e9b4f0fc21.text: A player watches the bounce and changes the next shot.

lxc_3a39792004e954ad.text: Every point starts with a serve.

lxc_a4beda79dd907c29.text: In an official serve, the ball begins on an open palm.

lxc_26cbebf43df83a04.text: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

lxc_46891f6c95c1fc24.text: The server hits the ball as it falls.

lxc_a9eae00da3d52bd8.text: The ball first bounces on the server’s side of the table.

lxc_7f8f1e73dec46045.text: Then it bounces on the other side.

lxc_d279436b3eec3c38.text: A server can change the speed, place, and spin.

lxc_ca915ff3a7021345.text: These changes can make the next shot difficult.

lxc_867ff0c6ed8828a0.text: A short backspin serve and a fast topspin serve can start two very different points.

lxc_e763a731bc24d77e.text: Table tennis began in England in the 1880s.

lxc_bdf65517c54948ae.text: People played it as an indoor form of lawn tennis.

lxc_420da06163253a15.text: They used a dining table and simple equipment they had around them.

lxc_e429e946ca31915c.text: The sport later became more organised.

lxc_b32bddd396c3634f.text: The International Table Tennis Federation, or ITTF, began in 1926.

lxc_e511b0354016402b.text: The first World Championships also took place in 1926, in London.

lxc_f9c36352363d24e7.text: A game for indoor tables had become an international sport.

lxc_11ffc2fa701c2ac8.text: Today, the table is still small, but players compete around the world.

lxc_95eba69ed6b848bf.text: He won the Olympic men’s singles title in 2016 and again at Tokyo 2020.

lxc_f144c8a2cc4823eb.text: He became the first man to win this Olympic singles title twice.

lxc_2aa3c3f26be7e395.text: At Tokyo 2020, she and Jun Mizutani won the first Olympic mixed doubles table tennis title.

lxc_5f292268f17c1d1f.text: It was also Japan’s first Olympic gold medal in table tennis.

lxc_8d450f5e80ad0eec.text: Ma Long’s result shows success across two Olympic Games.
